title: Marketplace Certification
description: Request certification for an asset to be published in the marketplace

elements.name: sla_info
elements.html:
SLA:

Marketplace certification typically takes 10-15 business days due to code review, security assessment, and documentation requirements. ML models require additional validation and may take up to 20 business days. Make sure your asset is production-ready before submitting.

elements.name: important_notes
elements.html:
Important Notes:
  • Assets must be production-ready and well-documented - incomplete assets will be rejected
  • Code quality matters - assets go through security and code review
  • Include clear documentation on how to use the asset - users need to understand it
  • ML models must include performance metrics and validation results
  • Pipelines should be tested and include error handling
  • Dashboards need to be self-explanatory with clear labels and descriptions
  • Consider the target audience - who will use this asset and why?
  • Assets in the marketplace are visible to all users - make sure they're appropriate for broad use
